department: Materials Science and Engineering Interdisciplinary Graduate Program

deadline.value: Apply by January 1 for Fall admission; there is no Spring admission.
deadline.quote: Deadline: Jan. 1 for admission to the Fall semester (No Spring admissions)

gre_general.value: The GRE is recommended but optional.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is recommended but optional

supervisor.value: You must name an MSE-affiliated faculty advisor when applying, and admission depends on that advisor agreeing to supervise and fund you.
supervisor.quote: Every Ph.D. applicant must identify an MSE-affiliated faculty advisor (or advisors) when applying to the program. | Eventual admission to the program is contingent upon a commitment from the advisor(s) to supervise the student and to support the student financially through the Ph.D. program.

funding.value: Admission requires the advisor's commitment to support you financially; students in good standing are supported through fellowships, TAs or RAs, subject to funds and progress.
funding.quote: Eventual admission to the program is contingent upon a commitment from the advisor(s) to supervise the student and to support the student financially through the Ph.D. program.

also.quote: Ph.D. students in good standing are supported through their graduate studies via a combination of fellowships, teaching assistantships, or research assistantships

entry_route.value: Applicants may come with a bachelor's or a master's degree; the page asks for a GPA of 3.0 across undergraduate study and any M.S. program.
entry_route.quote: A GPA of at least 3.0 or its equivalent for undergraduate study and M.S. program (if applicable)

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Polymer Science and Engineering is a separate UMass PhD program and is not covered here.
